notes.title: Now Available on Steam - Nostradamus: The Last Prophecy, 33% off!
notes.notes:
Nostradamus: The Last Prophecy is Now Available on Steam and is 33% off!*

Nostradamus: The Last Prophecy revolves around two versions of the same prophecy written by Nostradamus. One inspired by the discovery of a strange carved stone, a fragment from a ruin bearing ancestral signs. The other was more straightforward, harm was to come to the royal family.

*Offer ends May 1 at 10AM Pacific Time
